    • CONCAT

      public static final String CONCAT
      Concatenate operator. It appears in two distinct positions and the two are not interchangeable: inside $expr its value is a List of operands to join, while as a top-level update operator its value is a Map of field to the value appended to that field. Consumers of either form must type-check the value before reading it.

      public static Map<String, @Nullable Object> operator(String operator, @Nullable Object value)
      Creates a single-operator query map entry.

      operator - the operator name
      value - the value to match

      a singleton map containing the operator and value

    • expression

      public static Map<String,Object> expression(String operator, List<?> operands)
      Creates an expression query wrapping the given operator and operands.

      operator - the operator name
      operands - the list of operands
      Returns:
      a map containing the $expr expression
